title: Weekend Agenda: Zara Larsson, Hwang In-youp, Halloween and more
summary: Halloween weekend is bringing the party to Metro Manila, from Zara Larsson’s long-awaited concert and Hwang In-youp’s return to Manila to a two-night street party in Intramuros.
